scope: The complete live v019 sravn-/porovn-/poravn- mathematical comparison family, audited against the broader protected equality/ravn- inventory.
choice: Apply 31 exact context-bound edits: normalize true comparison forms to the official standard-orthography sravn-/sravnjenje paradigm, expand the citation imperative to sravni, and relexicalize four non-comparison contexts as identifikovati/identifikujut or prirěditi.
motivation: The reader mixed Polish/Czech/Slovak porovn-/poravn- surfaces with malformed sravnan-/sravnen-/sravniv- morphology and used compare verbs for mathematical identification and one-to-one assignment. The official comparison family supplies a consistent tie-breaker where independent-language evidence has no single alternative winner; context recasts prevent semantic overreach.
alternatives_rejected: Blindly replace every ravn-/rovn- form; 589 audited tokens express equality, equations, flatness, balance, or unrelated meanings.
Retain porovn-/poravn- variants; this leaves an accidental national-source mixture and risks South-Slavic level/align readings.
Use primerj-/uspored-/spored- corpus-wide; each regionalizes recognition toward a different branch and lacks a pan-family winner.
Treat identifying or assigning elements as comparison; four contexts instead require identifikovati/identifikujut or prirěditi.

evidence.native_family_balance: West PL/CS attest porówn-/srovn-/porovn-; South SL/HR/MK attest primerj-/uspored-/spored-; BE provides no decisive bounded witness. Each language counted once, not by token volume. With no independent-family winner, the official sravn- family is the stable edition-wide form.

validation.residue: zero porovn-/poravn-/srovn-/sravnan-/sravnen-/sravniv-, malformed imperative, or bare sravnjenj residue
validation.structure: TeX controls, references/citations, braces, math delimiters, and line counts unchanged
